narrative.weekly_mirror: On Eid, you wore the dress even with the house full of expectations, and Sami pulling the embroidery loose “honestly made me laugh.” You also kept moving through errands and corrections while making room for your own small choice and your family’s customs.
narrative.tension_explanation: The Eid preparations brought both pressures into the same space: your mother-in-law’s ways shaped the day, while you still chose what to wear and noticed how it felt to be seen by Huda and Tariq. The earlier exhaustion and asking for more time from the client also sit in the background, showing how much you were carrying.
